title: GTA 6 Fronts Next Game Informer Cover with New Info and Screenshots
description: GTA 6 is set to feature on the next Game Informer cover. A 14-page story with exclusive Rockstar interviews and new screenshots arrives on September 29, 2026.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Takes the Spotlight: Next Game Informer Cover and Details Preview

As anticipation continues to build for Rockstar Games' upcoming open-world blockbuster, the marketing machine is starting to ramp up. According to a recent report by gaming media outlet Push Square, *GTA 6* is officially taking the front cover of the next issue of *Game Informer*, bringing a wave of fresh information and visuals for fans to dissect.

### The Cover Feature: Jason and Lucia Hit the Road

The iconic duo, Jason and Lucia, take center stage on the upcoming magazine cover. The new stylized artwork depicts the two protagonists inside a car equipped with firearms, capturing the signature criminal escapade vibe that the *GTA* franchise is renowned for. This artwork reinforces the Bonnie and Clyde-style dynamic between the two main characters, teasing the intense driving and combat scenarios players can expect in the sprawling open world.

### What to Expect: 14-Page Deep Dive and New Screenshots

According to the outlet, the upcoming issue features an extensive **14-page cover story** dedicated entirely to Rockstar Games' next epic. This comprehensive feature includes **exclusive interviews** with the developers at Rockstar Games, alongside **a dozen new screenshots** showcasing the game's visuals and world design. The highly anticipated issue is scheduled to release on **Tuesday, 29th September 2026**.

### Context and What Lies Ahead

Major magazine cover stories have historically been pivotal moments for Rockstar's promotional campaigns, offering structured, in-depth looks at their titles ahead of launch. While the exact details of the developer interviews remain under wraps until the issue drops, the promise of over a dozen fresh screenshots will surely give the community plenty of material to analyze. Fans should mark their calendars for September 29th as the date when these new insights officially go live.

## Editor's Take

With a 14-page deep dive and a dozen new screenshots on the horizon, September 29th is shaping up to be a monumental day for *GTA 6* fans. Expect the new visuals and developer interviews to offer a clearer glimpse into Rockstar's next masterpiece as we count down to release.
